20m+，需基础与拉线: 20 m and up, needing a foundation and guys
临时架设，SOTA/POTA 常用。: Temporary installation, commonly used for SOTA/POTA.
基地台常用，倒 V、偶极天线。: Common at base stations, for inverted V and dipole antennas.
大型八木、高增益定向天线。: Large Yagis and high-gain directional antennas.
拉线用绝缘子分段，避免拉线感应电流影响天线方向图。: Break guys up with insulators, so induced currents in them do not distort the antenna pattern.
数米，玻璃钢/铝管: A few metres, fibreglass / aluminium tubing
架设远离电力线，雷雨天气停止操作并断开天线。: Keep away from power lines when erecting, and in thunderstorms stop operating and disconnect the antenna.
馈线进入室内前加装避雷器并就近接地。: Fit an arrester before the feedline enters the building and ground it nearby.
高度决定覆盖：VHF/UHF 天线越高越远，HF 则按波段选择合适高度。: Height determines coverage: on VHF/UHF higher means farther, while on HF the right height depends on the band.
